PZZ700-300915-
124 PM PDT Thu Oct 29 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1020 mb high was 600 nautical miles west of San
Francisco and a 1010 mb low covered the northern Gulf of
California. A weak offshore land breeze is expected near shore 
during the nights and mornings, with onshore flow prevailing each 
afternoon and evening through early Saturday. As a storm system
moves through the coastal waters this weekend, shifting winds  
and seas are likely to increase by Sunday morning, possibly to 
hazardous levels. There is a slight chance of thunderstorms 
Saturday night and Sunday morning. Winds decrease late Sunday. 
Seas diminish on Monday as offshore flow develops. 

$$
